author: ncorcoran29
quote: Game journalists should be ashamed of themselves. Nowhere near a perfect game. The story and stupid tasks like moving furniture and building ikea really kill this game. The storyline is blan and a borefest. I paid 100 just hoping when the stories over i can enjoy gta without the gay feminist slop!

author: ncorcoran29
quote: Very average game. Not even close to being worth $80. The 24 racers on grand prix is stupid and the fact that you cant do traditional 3 lap races and instead do a huge straightaway and 1 lap of a real track. Glad i bought the physical cause after 25 hours i did 90% and have no interest if i cant do a traditional 12 player 3 lap race. First time i felt completely lied to and ripped off by nintendo. Being a 80s/90s kid im hugely dissapointed.
